description: stablenet: 4 bp + 1 en on two implementations. node1 and node2 run gstable (default); node3, node4 and the endpoint run wbft-stablenet, an independent implementation that takes gstable's flags and data directories. Binaries: default = gstable, wbft = ${WBFT_STABLENET_BIN:-wbft-stablenet}; the fallback is a name nothing places by default, so build wbft-stablenet and put it on the target under that name or point WBFT_STABLENET_BIN at it. Used by 3 cases.
